Sobre a vaga

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Requirements gathering, designing, developing, testing, implementing, and supporting systems and processes related to Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). This position will work primarily on supporting business process, integrations and systems as it relates to WMS. In addition, the incumbent would be assisting with the support, maintenance, configuration and upgrades as it relates to those technologies. Finally, we are looking for an individual with a desire to focus on understanding business processes and learning tools and/or technologies related to WMS. The person in this position:
  3. Configure and develop solutions within WMS applications as assigned by more experienced team members.
  4. Test and verify completed configuration and development meets specifications.
  5. Work with other development analysts through iterations of development to gain acceptance and approval of testing before migrating to Production environment.
  6. Troubleshooting issues with existing processes and programs and working with business to resolve, test and migrate fixes to Production environment.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing tasks and working cross functionally with peers to achieve project goals.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Tested problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • A strong pattern of initiative.
  • Highly developed interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Proven ability to learn different business processes and technologies.
  • IBM iSeries experience (5 years)
  • Experience with reading and writing Cobol (5 years)
  • Experience with reading and writing SQL (5 years)

Preferred

  • Experience with reading and writing RPG (3 years)
  • Experience with reading and writing VB (3 years)

Requisitos adicionados pelo anunciante da vaga

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional com Warehouse Management Systems

• Mais de 3 anos de experiência profissional com Visual Basic

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional com SQL

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional com IBM iSeries

Entellux Technologies is an IT solutions, staffing, and corporate training company serving organizations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and LATAM. We specialize in IT staffing, headhunting, and talent augmentation, connecting companies with top professionals across cloud, software development, AI, cybersecurity, and enterprise technologies. Our clients span industries including banking, pharma, manufacturing, insurance, retail, and technology. In addition to staffing, Entellux provides corporate IT and professional training in areas such as Generative AI, AWS, Azure, cybersecurity, and programming, helping organizations build future-ready teams. At Entellux, we combine technology expertise, talent acquisition, and workforce development to help companies scale faster and stay competitive.
